title: MV Looking for Normal Civilian Clothes for RPG Maker MV NPCs

posts.author: Nephis
posts.body:
Hey everyone!
I’m working on a project in RPG Maker MV and I’ve hit a small roadblock.
I really need some
normal everyday clothes for NPCs/citizens
but specifically in a fantasy style, not modern. (the usual folders like
SV
,
TV
,
TVD
,
Face
, Variation) I’m having a hard time creating them myself.
If anyone has some ready-made outfits, or knows any free resources/packs that include simple civilian clothing, I’d really appreciate it.
Even a link or a small suggestion would help a lot.
Thanks so much in advance to anyone who can lend a hand!
